scenes: What happens to school in a heatwave?
In April 2024, Bangladesh closed schools for about thirty-three million children. | In the Philippines, more than five thousand schools moved to remote learning.
What helps: | cooler classrooms, | timetables that dodge the hottest hours, | and water and shade at every school.
Every closed day is learning lost. Plan to stay open.
